# Packages

Surfaces UI is 30 packages on npm, released together at one version, so any two of them always work together. Most apps install two to six of them; the rest come along as dependencies, or are parts of the server.

## What an app installs

| You want | Install |
|---|---|
| Components over your own backend (grid, chart, pivot, editor, explorers, forms) | `@surfaces-ui/components` `@surfaces-ui/data` |
| Pages and views an agent describes | add `@surfaces-ui/spec` |
| A chat thread with an agent | add `@surfaces-ui/chat`, and an agent backend |
| The reference server (DuckDB, Teradata, DataFusion) | `@surfaces-ui/client-connect` in the app, `@surfaces-ui/dev-server` beside it |
| SQL in the browser with no server | `@surfaces-ui/datasource-duckdb-wasm` and `@duckdb/duckdb-wasm` |
| All of it, set up | `npx create-surfaces my-app` |

React 18 or 19 is a peer of every package that draws: your app provides it.

Each package below links to its own README, with how to install and use it. "Brings" lists the other Surfaces UI packages a package depends on directly, and its larger third-party dependencies; peers are what your app provides.

## Start here

What an app installs itself. Each brings the foundations it needs.

| Package | What it is | Brings | Peers |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`@surfaces-ui/components`](../packages/components/README.md) | The components themselves: grids that stay fast at any size, charts, pivots, the SQL editor, schema and catalog browsing, data modelling, filters and the theme. | `data`, `proto`, `tokens`, `trace`, protobuf-es, CodeMirror, Apache Arrow, echarts | `react`, `react-dom` |
| [`@surfaces-ui/data`](../packages/data/README.md) | The interfaces every component uses (`DataSource`, `Discovery`, `Pipelines`, `Semantics`, `StateStorage`), Arrow helpers, the plain filter form, and in-memory implementations for tests and demos. | `proto`, protobuf-es, Apache Arrow | none |
| [`@surfaces-ui/spec`](../packages/spec/README.md) | Agent-generated UI: the component catalog, the A2UI surface model, the agent prompt generated from the catalog, and `SurfaceView`, which draws what an agent sends after checking it against the catalog. | `components`, `data`, `proto`, `tokens`, `trace`, protobuf-es, zod | `react`, `react-dom` |
| [`@surfaces-ui/chat`](../packages/chat/README.md) | Chat threads whose replies hold live components: streaming text, tool steps, approvals, and any catalog component drawn inline. | `agent`, `components`, `proto`, `spec`, `state`, `trace`, protobuf-es | `react`, `react-dom` |
| [`@surfaces-ui/state`](../packages/state/README.md) | State services with no React or DOM dependency: stores, derived values, undo, persistence to any `StateStorage`, URL sync, the shared view state behind cross-filtering, and query runs. | `data`, `proto`, protobuf-es | `react` (optional) |
| [`@surfaces-ui/devtools`](../packages/devtools/README.md) | Developer tools for agent-generated UI: one component around your app records messages, components, problems, state, events, agent turns and service calls, with time travel. | `components`, `data`, `spec`, `trace` | `react`, `react-dom` |
| [`@surfaces-ui/client-connect`](../packages/client-connect/README.md) | The client side of the dev server's services over Connect: `connectDataSource`, `connectDiscovery`, `connectAgent` and the rest, each implementing the matching interface from `@surfaces-ui/data` or `@surfaces-ui/agent`. | `data`, `proto`, Connect | none |
| [`@surfaces-ui/dev-server`](../packages/dev-server/README.md) | A Connect server for your data: DuckDB (files, Delta, Iceberg, object stores, Postgres), Teradata and DataFusion behind one set of read-only services, with search, pipelines and an agent. | `agent`, `data`, `discovery`, `engine`, `engine-datafusion`, `engine-duckdb`, `engine-service`, `engine-teradata`, `pipelines`, `pipelines-dbt`, `proto`, `seeds`, `sql`, protobuf-es, Connect, Apache Arrow | none |
| [`create-surfaces`](../packages/create-surfaces/README.md) | Starts a new app: a dashboard page, a chat that draws live components, and a data server with six sample datasets. | nothing | none |

## Agent backends

One of these turns a model into an `AgentBackend` for `Chat`, `PageStudio` or the dev server. Install the one you use.

| Package | What it is | Brings | Peers |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`@surfaces-ui/agent`](../packages/agent/README.md) | The `AgentBackend` interface (one `send` is one turn), event helpers, a scripted agent for tests, `toolCallingAgent` for any model with tool calls, and `dataTools`, which lets a model list and describe tables (never their values). | `data`, `proto`, protobuf-es | none |
| [`@surfaces-ui/agent-anthropic`](../packages/agent-anthropic/README.md) | An `AgentBackend` over Claude through the official Anthropic SDK, which you install alongside it. | `agent` | `@anthropic-ai/sdk` |
| [`@surfaces-ui/agent-openai`](../packages/agent-openai/README.md) | An `AgentBackend` over any OpenAI-compatible `/chat/completions` endpoint: OpenAI, Ollama, vLLM or LM Studio. | `agent` | none |
| [`@surfaces-ui/agent-loom`](../packages/agent-loom/README.md) | An `AgentBackend` that talks to a running Loom server over its HTTP gateway. | `agent`, `proto`, protobuf-es | none |

## Inside the server

`@surfaces-ui/dev-server` installs these itself. Install one directly only to build a server of your own.

| Package | What it is | Brings | Peers |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`@surfaces-ui/engine`](../packages/engine/README.md) | The `Engine` interface the server's engine adapters implement. | `proto`, protobuf-es, Apache Arrow | none |
| [`@surfaces-ui/engine-service`](../packages/engine-service/README.md) | The query, catalog and source services over engine adapters, usable in Node or a browser. | `client-connect`, `data`, `engine`, `proto`, `sql`, protobuf-es, Connect, Apache Arrow | none |
| [`@surfaces-ui/engine-duckdb`](../packages/engine-duckdb/README.md) | DuckDB as an engine (Node, ADBC): Parquet, CSV and JSON files, Delta and Iceberg tables, time travel, and file access locked to the registered tables. | `engine`, `proto`, DuckDB (native, through ADBC), protobuf-es, Apache Arrow | none |
| [`@surfaces-ui/engine-teradata`](../packages/engine-teradata/README.md) | Teradata as an engine, through Teradata Query Service or a driver connection you supply. | `engine`, `proto`, `sql`, protobuf-es, Apache Arrow | none |
| [`@surfaces-ui/engine-datafusion`](../packages/engine-datafusion/README.md) | Apache DataFusion as an engine, over a server's HTTP SQL endpoint (ROAPI), reading Arrow. | `engine`, `proto`, `sql`, protobuf-es, Apache Arrow | none |
| [`@surfaces-ui/sql`](../packages/sql/README.md) | Turns a view (sort, filter, page, group, aggregate, bucket) into SQL for each engine's dialect, with every value bound as a parameter, plus read-only checks. | `data`, `proto`, protobuf-es, @polyglot-sql/sdk | none |
| [`@surfaces-ui/discovery`](../packages/discovery/README.md) | The reference discovery backend: keyword and semantic search over tables and columns, profiles, inferred joins and context packs for agents, on any `DataSource`. | `data`, `proto`, protobuf-es, Apache Arrow | none |
| [`@surfaces-ui/embedder-local`](../packages/embedder-local/README.md) | A small embedding model run on your machine for semantic search. | `discovery`, Transformers.js | none |
| [`@surfaces-ui/pipelines`](../packages/pipelines/README.md) | The reference pipeline runner: builds datasets from one another on an engine, in dependency order, with row rules and checks over what was built. | `data`, `engine`, `proto`, `sql`, protobuf-es | none |
| [`@surfaces-ui/pipelines-dbt`](../packages/pipelines-dbt/README.md) | A dbt project as a pipeline: datasets, tests, runs and semantic models read from dbt's artifacts. | `data`, `proto`, protobuf-es | none |
| [`@surfaces-ui/seeds`](../packages/seeds/README.md) | Six synthetic industry datasets (retail, healthcare, fraud, telco, transportation, manufacturing) with keys, descriptions, planted data problems, pipelines, starter pages and written conversations. | `data`, `spec` | none |

## Foundations

Shared by the packages above and installed with them. You import from them (a theme, a trace), but rarely add them yourself.

| Package | What it is | Brings | Peers |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`@surfaces-ui/tokens`](../packages/tokens/README.md) | The theme contract, eight presets, colour derivation tested for contrast, and the CSS variables (`--sf-*`) every component is styled with. | nothing | none |
| [`@surfaces-ui/proto`](../packages/proto/README.md) | TypeScript generated from the protobuf contracts that cross process boundaries (queries, catalogs, agents, pipelines). | protobuf-es | none |
| [`@surfaces-ui/trace`](../packages/trace/README.md) | The recorder behind the developer tools. | nothing | `react` (optional) |

## Worth knowing

- **The data layer is optional.** `components`, `spec`, `chat` and the other packages that draw depend only on the `DataSource` interface in `@surfaces-ui/data`, never on an engine, a driver, a Connect client or the server (`pnpm check:boundaries` holds this). An app on its own backend implements `DataSource` and installs nothing from the server side.
- **`@surfaces-ui/dev-server` brings every engine.** It depends on the DuckDB, Teradata and DataFusion adapters, the pipeline runner and dbt support, so a server that only reads Teradata still installs DuckDB's native library.
- **No Teradata driver is installed.** `@surfaces-ui/engine-teradata` talks to Teradata Query Service over `fetch`, or to a driver connection your server opens with a driver you install yourself.
- **Before the first release (0.2.0), each package was checked on its own**: packed as npm publishes it, installed alone into an empty project, and every JavaScript entry imported; the app `create-surfaces` writes was then installed from those packages, built, and its data server started and answered. Releasing is described in [releasing.md](releasing.md).
